title: New Mexico Stamp Loop
subtitle: Albuquerque → Jemez Mountains → Santa Fe → Salt Missions → the old Zuni–Acoma trail. A Thursday-night-to-Sunday-night fly-in, ready to drop onto any long weekend.

days.title: Fly to Albuquerque
days.html:
✈︎

OAK → ABQ after work

Southwest nonstop, about 6:00 PM Pacific to 9:15 PM Mountain (sample timing). Clocks jump an hour forward.

Shuttle to the Sunport Rental Car Center and pick up the Costco Travel rental tonight, so Friday can start early.

Sleep at the Best Western Airport Albuquerque InnSuites, 2400 Yale Blvd SE (nights 1 and 3).

Navigate to hotel ↗
Before picking dates: skip Thanksgiving and Christmas weekends, when most of these stops close. Mid-May to mid-October means the Bandelier shuttle; November to April means possible snow on NM-4 and at the Valles Caldera gate. Book 2 hotels: the Airport InnSuites for nights 1 and 3, Santa Fe for night 2. America the Beautiful + Access Pass cover entrance fees.

days.title: Caldera to cliff dwellings
days.sub: Albuquerque → Valles Caldera → Los Alamos → Bandelier → Santa Fe
days.cut: Jemez Springs is the last easy stop for gas. Check Valles Caldera alerts the night before, and keep Day 1 on a Friday: the Manhattan Project desk is open Friday to Monday only.

days.title: Pecos and the Salt Missions
days.sub: Santa Fe → Pecos → Moriarty → Quarai → Mountainair → Abó → Albuquerque
days.cut: Salinas hours are 9 AM – 4 PM Nov–Mar and 10 AM – 5 PM Apr–Oct, so in winter keep moving after lunch to reach Abó well before 4.

days.title: Inscriptions, lava, petroglyphs
days.sub: Albuquerque → El Morro → El Malpais → Petroglyph → Old Town → home
days.cut: Check out with luggage. Day 3 is the trip’s only backtrack: El Morro is a dead end off NM-53. Gas up in Grants; stations are sparse west of it. Petroglyph’s stamp desk closes at 4:30.

stops.via: I-25 → US-550 → NM-4, the Jemez Mountain Trail. Red cliffs at Jemez Pueblo, then the Soda Dam roadside pullout.
stops.name: Valles Caldera NPres
stops.where: Volcano Discovery Center, 4 miles down the entrance road
stops.hrs: Vehicle gate 9 AM – 5 PM most of the year (8 AM – 6 PM Memorial Day to Labor Day). Closed Thanksgiving and Christmas.
stops.warn: In winter, snow can close or delay the gate. Check park alerts the night before.
stops.ok: Drive-up views of the Valle Grande. The eruption show runs every hour on the half hour.
stops.about: A volcanic caldera about 13 miles across, left by a huge eruption some 1.25 million years ago. Its grassy valles are home to a big elk herd.

stops.via: Leave about 10:15. NM-4 → NM-501 into Los Alamos.
stops.name: Manhattan Project NHP
stops.hrs: Friday–Monday 10 AM – 3 PM; closed Tuesday–Thursday. NPS.gov doesn’t post these hours, so call ahead.
stops.warn: If the NPS desk is closed, stamps are kept at the Los Alamos County Visitor Center in the same building. Call (505) 661-6277 the week before.
stops.ok: Includes one-third of the three-part Los Alamos / Oak Ridge / Hanford stamp. Lunch in Los Alamos, 11:30 – 12:20.
stops.about: The secret wartime laboratory where the first atomic bombs were designed. The park is shared with Oak Ridge, Tennessee, and Hanford, Washington.

stops.name: Bandelier NM
stops.warn: Mid-May to mid-October, cars arriving 9 AM – 3 PM must park at the White Rock Visitor Center and ride the shuttle in. Off-season, drive straight to the canyon.
stops.acc: The first stretch of the Main Loop Trail passes the Big Kiva and Tyuonyi village. The cliff dwellings need ladders, so enjoy them from below.
stops.about: Ancestral Pueblo people carved homes into the soft volcanic tuff of Frijoles Canyon and farmed the mesas here for about 400 years.

stops.name: Santa Fe, NM
stops.addr: Best Western Plus Inn of Santa Fe, 3650 Cerrillos Rd, Santa Fe, NM
stops.note: Best Western Plus Inn of Santa Fe, 3650 Cerrillos Rd. Dinner around the Santa Fe Plaza, about 15 minutes north. Tomorrow starts at 8:25 AM.

stops.name: Pecos NHP
stops.addr: Pecos National Historical Park Visitor Center
stops.hrs: 8:30 AM – 4 PM early April to early November; 9 AM – 4 PM in winter. Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year’s Day.
stops.ok: Museum and film. The 1.25-mile Ancestral Sites Trail to the mission church is optional.
stops.about: Pecos Pueblo sat on the trade route between the Pueblo villages and the Plains tribes. The ruins of its Spanish mission church still stand above the valley.

stops.via: Leave about 10:00. I-25 south → NM-41 south.
stops.name: Lunch in Moriarty
stops.place: Route 66 town, right on the way

stops.via: Leave about 11:50. NM-41 south through Estancia → NM-542.
stops.name: Salinas Pueblo Missions NM
stops.addr: Quarai, Salinas Pueblo Missions National Monument
stops.hrs: 10 AM – 5 PM Apr–Oct; 9 AM – 4 PM Nov–Mar. Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year’s Day.
stops.ok: Red sandstone mission church on a short half-mile loop. Two more Salinas cancellations follow at Mountainair and Abó.
stops.about: Three Spanish mission churches built in the 1600s beside Pueblo villages. Drought, famine and raids emptied all three in the 1670s.

stops.name: Mountainair Headquarters

bonus.title: Extra Salinas cancellation · Mountainair HQ
bonus.where: Main visitor center, 105 S Ripley Ave. Ask whether they also hold the Gran Quivira stamp.
bonus.hrs: 10 AM – 5 PM Apr–Oct; 9 AM – 4 PM Nov–Mar.

stops.note: Optional: Gran Quivira is 25 miles south and back, adding about 1.5 hours round trip.

stops.name: Abó
stops.addr: Abo, Salinas Pueblo Missions National Monument

bonus.title: Extra Salinas cancellation · Abó
bonus.hrs: 10 AM – 5 PM Apr–Oct; 9 AM – 4 PM Nov–Mar.

stops.note: The last of the three Salinas sites. Leave about 2:40 for Albuquerque.

stops.via: Leave about 2:40. US-60 west → NM-47 north → I-25 north.
stops.name: Albuquerque, NM
stops.addr: Best Western Airport Albuquerque InnSuites, 2400 Yale Blvd SE, Albuquerque, NM
stops.note: Best Western Airport InnSuites, 2400 Yale Blvd SE. Dinner in Old Town Albuquerque. Tomorrow starts at 7:00 AM; check out with your luggage.

stops.via: I-40 west → exit 81 → NM-53. Gas up in Grants on the way; stations are sparse west of it.
stops.name: El Morro NM
stops.addr: El Morro National Monument Visitor Center
stops.hrs: 9 AM – 5 PM. Daily late May to mid-October; Thursday–Monday the rest of the year (closed Tuesday and Wednesday). Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year’s Day.
stops.ok: The half-mile Inscription Loop passes the pool and centuries of carved signatures. Arrive by 4 PM to walk it (2:30 PM for the longer Headland Trail). Trail status (505) 783-4226 x801.
stops.about: A sandstone bluff with a hidden pool, where Ancestral Puebloans, Spanish travelers and U.S. Army surveyors all carved their marks over the centuries.

stops.via: Leave about 10:15. NM-53 back to I-40 exit 85.
stops.name: El Malpais NM
stops.addr: El Malpais National Monument Visitor Center, 1900 E Santa Fe Ave, Grants, NM
stops.where: Visitor center, 1900 E Santa Fe Ave (I-40 exit 85)
stops.hrs: Daily 9 AM – 5 PM. Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year’s Day.
stops.about: “Malpais” means badlands: rugged lava flows, lava tubes and cinder cones from a volcanic field that last erupted a few thousand years ago.

stops.via: Leave about 12:15. I-40 east → Unser Blvd.
stops.name: Petroglyph NM
stops.addr: Petroglyph National Monument Visitor Center, 6510 Western Trail NW, Albuquerque
stops.hrs: 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM. Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year’s Day.
stops.ok: No petroglyphs here; it’s the stamp and map stop. Boca Negra is next.
stops.about: Thousands of images pecked into the dark volcanic boulders of Albuquerque’s West Mesa, most by Ancestral Pueblo people several hundred years ago.

stops.via: Leave about 2:00. Unser Blvd north → Atrisco Dr.
stops.name: Boca Negra Canyon
stops.note: About 100 petroglyphs close to the parking areas. The Macaw Trail is a 5-minute walk.
stops.acc: Paths are partly paved but not wheelchair accessible.
stops.warn: Open 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM; last entry 4 PM.

stops.name: Old Town Albuquerque
stops.note: San Felipe de Neri church and the plaza. Leave about 5:15 to return the car.

stops.title: Albuquerque → home
stops.note: Return the car at the Sunport Rental Car Center and shuttle to the terminal; aim to be at security by 6:15. ABQ ~7:50 PM → OAK, often via SAN (sample timing). Home around 11:30 PM Pacific.
